en.headline: Silver Bond due 2027 to pay 4 per cent on fourth coupon
en.dek: The HKMA set the rate at the 4 per cent fixed floor after the inflation-linked floating rate came in at 1.80 per cent.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said on Thursday that the fourth interest payment on the Silver Bond series due 2027 will be made at 4.00 per cent a year.

The authority, acting for the government, announced the rate for the bonds issued under the Infrastructure Bond Programme, issue number 03GB2710R. Under the issue circular of 30 September 2024, the fourth payment is due on 23 October 2026, and the rate was to be fixed on 8 October as the higher of the prevailing floating rate and the fixed rate.

On Thursday the floating rate stood at 1.80 per cent and the fixed rate at 4.00 per cent, so the payment rate is 4.00 per cent. The floating rate is the arithmetic average of the year-on-year change in the 2019/20-based Composite Consumer Price Index from March to August 2026, which the authority listed as 1.70, 1.70, 2.00, 2.00, 1.70 and 1.70 per cent.
The announcement sets the coupon for this payment date only. It does not change the bond's maturity or the method used to set later payments.

zh.headline: 2027年到期銀債第四次付息年利率定為4厘
zh.dek: 金管局公布浮息為1.80厘，低於4厘定息，故今次按較高的定息支付，付息日為10月23日。
body: 香港金融管理局星期四公布，2027年到期銀色債券系列第四次付息的年利率定為4.00厘。
金管局以政府代表身分公布有關息率。該批債券在基礎建設債券計劃下發行，發行編號為03GB2710R。按2024年9月30日的發行通函，第四個付息日為2026年10月23日，息率於10月8日按當時浮息與定息的較高者釐定。
星期四的浮息為年息1.80厘，定息為年息4.00厘，因此今次付息按4.00厘計算。浮息是2026年3月至8月、以2019/20年為基期的綜合消費物價指數按年變動率的算術平均數。金管局列出的各月數字依次為1.70、1.70、2.00、2.00、1.70及1.70。
今次公布只適用於這個付息日，並不改變債券到期日，亦不改變其後付息的計算方法。
